## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior.

## Validation

Record checks actually run, results, and limitations.

## Editorial changes, if applicable

Follow [the editorial harness](https://github.com/Honeypot-Finance/honeypot-landing/blob/main/docs/editorial-harness.md). For a new article or substantial rewrite, link `docs/editorial-reviews/<slug>.md` and include the selected hook, thesis, opening/ending check, source verification, and issues fixed. For a layout-only change, describe the applicable visual and content-preservation checks here. Remove this section for unrelated work.

- [ ] Argument and closing insight reviewed; remaining concerns disclosed.
- [ ] Article-specific cover, inline animation, Florus credit, and useful summaries verified.
- [ ] Relevant reading, route, source-link, accessibility, and build checks reported.
